customer_text:
Hi Grace,

Thank you for following up, and sorry for the wait - you've been patient longer than you should have had to be.

I can see the withdrawal of $120 from 22 September. On our side it shows as completed, which means the payment provider confirmed it to us. That isn't the same as you having received it, and I take your word that it hasn't reached your e-wallet.

I can't reissue the payment from here, and I'm not going to tell you it's resolved when it isn't. What's needed is a check of the payment with the provider, matched against the e-wallet it was sent to.

To help with that, could you confirm which e-wallet provider you use and whether you've checked the transaction history in that wallet?

I'm sorry I can't give you a date for when that check will be finished.
internal_notes: Route Payments (baseline accepted), P2, escalation saved. TX-86735: 120.00 USD, QuickPay, created 2026-09-22T02:10Z, updated 2026-09-26T11:30Z, status completed. `completed` = provider confirmed to us, NOT proof of receipt → completed-but-receipt-disputed. Required action is verification/tracing, not a reissue and not a second payment; the draft explicitly refuses to reissue and refuses to declare resolution. It asks for the e-wallet provider and a check of the wallet's transaction history so a human can trace it. Deliberately omitted: the internal 2 Oct QuickPay expectation, any claim that the money is on its way, and any repeat of the unsupported "up to 5 days" from closed ticket T-5015. Human action: Payments to trace TX-86735 with QuickPay against the destination wallet before anything else happens. Sources: support-handbook-v2.md#withdrawals, finance-month-end-sept.md#payment-providers, transactions.csv#TX-86735.
limitations: Automated checks are limited. A person must verify and send; no communication has been sent.
